SBP: Intern has patient sign consent form.
ICS: Introduces themselves & identifies their role as cross-cover provider.
Intern discusses the anemia due to GI blood loss and recommendation for blood transfusion.
Intern discusses the risk of blood transfusion  a. Allergic reaction  b. Infection transmission  c. Other (e.g., TACO, TRALI, fever, etc.)
Intern discusses benefits of transfusion (ex: oxygen delivery, function of organs, etc)
Intern discusses no transfusion as an option, and what the plan would be.
Intern discusses alternates to transfusion (e.g. fluids, IV iron)
Intern checks for understanding from the patient. Asks if they have questions.
